name: Action Construction Equipment Ltd
title: Action Construction Equipment Ltd - 532762 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Action Construction is still capacity-heavy at ~60% utilisation, with management pushing 9-10% price hikes (targeting 11-14% total) against steel up 20-22%, while guiding FY29 revenue of INR6,000-6,200 crore and pausing a INR400 crore tower-crane plant.

utilisation.quote: Our blended capacity utilization for cranes, metal handling and construction equipment stands at around 60%

capex.quote: we will just wait and watch and wait for the momentum. And as soon as we see things, so maybe within this year, we'll start working on that.

triggers.label: Blended utilisation ~60%
triggers.quote: Our blended capacity utilization for cranes, metal handling and construction equipment stands at around 60%

triggers.label: Price hikes 9-10%, cost 11-14%
triggers.quote: This will bring the total to 9% to 10%. But I think looking at the overall cost increase, it could be anywhere between the range of 11% to 14%

triggers.label: Tower-crane plant INR400 cr on hold
triggers.quote: So currently, we have capacity. So we will just wait and watch and wait for the momentum.

triggers.label: Antidumping order not notified
triggers.quote: for some good bad reason, it has not been notified by the Ministry of Finance

triggers.label: Annual guidance deferred to Q2
triggers.quote: we've also refrain ed from giving an annual guidance so far

guidance.quote: INR6,000 crores to INR6,200 crores by FY '29 and worst case by FY '30
we are hopeful that we should be able to sustain our margin profile, EBITDA without other income in the range of around 15% to 16%
our capex for this year should all be put together should be close to INR200 crores
that should be upwards of INR200 crores, INR200 crores, INR220 crores
in the next three to four years, we should be looking at a revenue of upwards of INR300 crores from this joint venture

prior_guidance_check.quote: we should be on track to attaining this INR6,000 crores plus in FY '29 or latest by FY '30
we would like to give only sometime middle of quarter 2

red_flags.label: Other income negative on MTM losses
red_flags.quote: we do a mark -to-mark provisioning at the end of every month

red_flags.label: Cranes ~INR831 cr investments in bonds/debentures
red_flags.quote: So like outflow of INR831 crores of cash

red_flags.label: Export shipments stuck due to Middle East war
red_flags.quote: some of our export shipments, which are still stuck with us and have not moved because they were meant for Middle East

evasions.quote: to put a number to it, either in form of numbers or, let's say, in the form of turnover or percentage, we would like to do that only in the second half of quarter
It is going to be very difficult rather because first of all, we have to hang on to the customers
